items.expected_conclusion: Within the isolated-molecule computational boundary, both emissive states are assigned mixed metal/halide-to-ligand charge-transfer ((M+X)LCT) character, supported by state-resolved orbital/transition-density analysis and emission calculations near 689 nm (S1) and 605 nm (T1).
The isolated-molecule wavelengths should not be presented as the solid-state emission peak; the paper attributes their difference to crystal-environment effects.
